title: In the wake of Tippett Studios’ closure, a digital archive appears online
summary: Tippett Studios, a renowned CGI animation studio famous for work on Jurassic Park and other films, closed down and a comprehensive digital archive of their animated materials, behind-the-scenes content, and creative work has been uploaded to the Internet Archive for public preservation and access.
problem_solved: Preserves the creative legacy and technical artifacts of Tippett Studios after its closure, preventing the loss of valuable animation history and educational materials.
why_valuable: This archive serves as an important educational resource and cultural preservation effort, allowing future generations of animators and filmmakers to study the techniques and history of pioneering CGI work.
